title: SMS reminders are in release 1, sent through Eskiz
decision: SMS reminders are part of release 1 and the provider is Eskiz. The agent writes the sender; the contract, the sender name and the message templates in Eskiz's cabinet, and turning the switch on, are the founder's. The switch stays off until he turns it on
context: Answered by the founder on 2026-10-08 when asked by the agent in the working session
rationale: The founder was asked whether SMS is in release 1 and chose Eskiz over leaving SMS out and over Play Mobile
